source.entry: Ecma Office Open XML Part 2 - Open Packaging Conventions.pdf

reviewedSections.finding: Content types may be supplied by a matching Default, Override, or both; Override wins. Duplicate mappings are prohibited; mapping order does not matter.
Look up the part name in Overrides first, then use the final path segment extension in Defaults. Both comparisons use ASCII case-insensitive matching.

application: The independent writer uses a Default for the workbook main XML and Overrides for other XML parts. Current failure was caused by missing Default lookup, not by a modified or malformed fixture. Macro/unknown workbook types still require the existing explicit rejection.
boundary: Specification review only; source, Worker and full-App behavior have separate evidence.
